definition: Ear, nose and throat surgery, ENT for short. The full name is otorhinolaryngology, which is why nobody says it out loud.
Eye specialist doctor, who does cataract surgery, among other things. Note the PH before the TH: ‘opthalmologist’ is the most common misspelling in medicine. World Glaucoma Week.
Brain disorder of overwhelming daytime sleepiness and sudden sleep attacks, sometimes with cataplexy: muscles going floppy with laughter or surprise. World Sleep Day.
Tendency to repeated unprovoked seizures. Seizure first aid: time it, protect the head, nothing in the mouth, recovery position once it stops. Purple Day.
